messages.subject: isolating selectinput
parts:
Hello

I am trying to do a plot on selecting some variables using select input and need to plot only on plot action button.   This works first time with the plot action button but
will plot without action button for next selections..     I use the observe event for action button..   

 Not sure what I am missing..    Appreciate your help..

observeEvent(input$feplot, {
    plotfe()
  })
  
     
  plotfe <- function(){
    inFile <- input$file1
    if (is.null(inFile)) return(NULL)
    
    data <- read.csv(inFile$datapath, header = TRUE)
    if (input$predict){
      fe <- predict(earthmodel,data)
    }
    output$feplot <- renderPlot({
      # plot(data[,1],fe)  # Engine RPM
      
      x = as.integer(input$select)
      if (x == 1 ){
      EngineRPM = data[,x]
      hist(EngineRPM, col= c( "green","red"))
      }
      
      if (x == 2 ){
        VehicleSpeed = data[,x]
        hist(VehicleSpeed, col= c( "green","red"))
      }
      
      if (x == 3 ){
        acceleration = data [,x]
        hist(acceleration, col= c( "green","red"))
      }
      
      
      
    })
    
  }
